result.instructions: Tools for Buildium, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Buildium data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run buildium_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run buildium_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run buildium_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. buildium_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: buildium_create_work_order
tools.title: Create a work order
tools.description: Create a work order for a vendor. Attach it to an existing task (task_id) or create a new task with it (task: title, priority, status, assigned staff user, optional due date/property/unit). vendor_id and entry_allowed are required. Line items are optional (quantity x unit price, optional GL account). Buildium: POST /v1/workorders.

entry_allowed.description: Whether entry to the unit is allowed.

chargeable_to.description: Who will be charged for the work (max 100).

entry_contact_ids.description: Entry contact user ids (RentalTenant, AssociationOwner, Staff or RentalOwner).

task_id.description: Existing task to attach this work order to.

task.description: A new task to create and link to this work order (instead of task_id).

assigned_to_user_id.description: Staff user id assigned to the task.

tools.name: buildium_update_work_order
tools.title: Update a work order
tools.description: Update a work order's details. Buildium's PUT replaces the whole record, so this reads the current work order first and only changes the fields you pass — everything else (including line items and entry contacts) is preserved. Passing line_items REPLACES all existing line items. Status/priority/due date live on the linked task. Buildium: GET then PUT /v1/workorders/{workOrderId}.

entry_allowed.description: Whether entry to the unit is allowed.

entry_contact_ids.description: Replace the entry contact user ids.

line_items.description: Replace ALL line items with this list.

assigned_to_user_id.description: Staff user id assigned to the task.

tools.name: buildium_update_todo_task
tools.title: Update a to-do task
tools.description: Update a to-do task — change status (e.g. mark Completed), priority, assignee, due date, title or category, optionally with an update message. Buildium's PUT replaces the whole record, so this reads the current task first and only changes the fields you pass. Buildium: GET then PUT /v1/tasks/todorequests/{toDoTaskId}.

assigned_to_user_id.description: Reassign to this staff user id.
